visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair, wearing a white strapless top and denim shorts, gestures with her hands while smiling at the camera. Yellow subtitles appear at the bottom. (2) She walks across a spacious outdoor balcony area. Her hands point towards the large space which includes white outdoor sofas with blue cushions and glass railings. The background shows an industrial port with various cranes and buildings under a slightly overcast sky. White text overlays are visible at the bottom. (3) The scene shifts indoors where the woman jumps and falls face-down onto a large bed covered in crisp white linens. The room features luxurious gold-toned wallpaper and a large flat-screen TV on the wall. The lighting is warm and bright, typical of a high-end hotel room. Subtitles appear in the center-bottom. (4) Sitting on a small beige fabric sofa, she talks to the camera, using expressive hand movements. A white towel and a remote control are visible nearby. The background consists of heavy tan curtains and a patterned wall, illuminated by soft indoor lighting. White subtitles are displayed at the bottom. (5) She enters a modern bathroom, showing her face and upper body as she gestures toward a standalone white bathtub. The room features a long vanity with a large lit mirror and marble-patterned walls. The floor is covered in small mosaic tiles, and the lighting is bright and sterile. Text overlays are visible at the bottom. (6) The woman walks through a glass door into a shower area, then shows a walk-in closet with light-colored wooden shelves and integrated LED lighting. Her hands touch the closet frame as she moves. The background is filled with organized storage spaces and some hanging clothes. Subtitles continue to appear at the bottom. (7) Moving into a large living room, she passes multiple white sofas and a round wooden coffee table. A person in a black hoodie is visible in the background, sitting and using a laptop. The room is large and well-lit with various decorative objects on the tables. White text is visible at the bottom of the frame. (8) She shows a secondary, smaller bedroom with a bed and some bags on the floor. Her hands point around the room. The setting is a standard interior cabin with functional lighting and neutral-colored walls. Captions appear at the bottom. (9) Back on the balcony, she leans against a white metal railing while looking out at the port. Her hair blows slightly in the wind. The background features several red cranes and large ships docked in the distance under a bright sky. Subtitles are visible at the bottom. (10) In a final shot, the woman and a friend are seen in a mirror reflection, holding a smartphone to record a selfie. They both smile and gesture with their hands. The bathroom setting provides a brightly lit, clean background with wood-paneled walls visible in the reflection. Final subtitles and captions appear at the bottom.
